description: Check which competitive signals RivalSweeper has for an eCommerce domain, with per-signal freshness (for prices: when a price was last read, plus the share of priced products read in the last 7 days; records counts products, each product once however many variant rows it has; for large catalogs these come from a sample and are marked records_approximate). A signal is available exactly when its tool has data: promotions counts the live offers get_active_promotions_and_coupons returns, prices follow get_brand_price_statistics. Free and non-billable.
name: check_brand_data_coverage
title: Signal coverage for a domain (free)
